goal: Allow single-task checkout_delivery in both manual and auto modes to treat staged or untracked regular files in the coordinator checkout that match the target commit's blob and executable mode byte-for-byte as satisfied while keeping all mismatches fail-closed, and prevent copyLanePlanningInput from overwriting a newer Spec on the Lane branch when the coordinator copy matches base_head, per D2 of docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-3; meet D2.1 and BR-SCN-2 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/single-task-checkout-delivery.test.ts, tests/single-task-lane-batch.test.ts. Done looks like: untracked (??) or staged regular files (such as docs/plans/<id>.intent.json and docs/specs/<slug>.spec.md) in the coordinator checkout whose content blob and executable mode match the completed Lane commit byte-for-byte pass inspectSingleTaskDelivery and deliverSingleTask cleanly in both manual and auto modes without checkout_delivery_overlap, with auto mode staging satisfied paths prior to git merge --ff-only. Negative: any byte content difference, executable mode mismatch (100644 vs 100755), symlink at the path, or path deleted by target while modified or untracked in the coordinator checkout refuses with checkout_delivery_overlap and leaves coordinator HEAD untouched.

Source BR-REQ-2; meet D2.2 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/single-task-lane-batch.test.ts. Done looks like: when an earlier Slice updated a shared docs/specs/*.spec.md on imm/<slug> while the coordinator checkout copy still matches base_head, copyLanePlanningInput for a subsequent Slice preserves the Lane HEAD Spec instead of overwriting and staging the stale coordinator copy. Negative: when the coordinator checkout holds a Spec that differs from base_head (such as an uncommitted candidate Spec), copyLanePlanningInput copies and stages the coordinator Spec into the Lane worktree.
